description:
Returns the four MTD for Income Tax quarterly update periods for a tax year (standard and calendar period ends), each deadline, the final declaration date, and days until the next deadline. Works without signing in.
Use this when: someone asks when the next quarterly update is due or what a Quarter covers.
Not for: whether a particular Client has sent records (whos_outstanding).

tax_year.description: e.g. "2026-27". Default: the current tax year.

name: get_mtd_deadlines
title: MTD deadlines
